regions.today: Bright and breezy today with sunny spells and just a few showers, mainly further north in the province. Highest temperatures of 15 to 19 degrees, warmest in the southeast, with moderate to fresh southwest to west winds.
regions.tonight: Dry with clear spells. Lowest temperatures of 7 to 11 degrees, with light to moderate southwest to west winds, easing through the night.
regions.tomorrow: Plenty of dry and bright weather with sunny spells, before cloud thickens from the southwest later in the afternoon and evening.Highest temperatures of 16 to 19 degrees, with light variable breezes becoming southerly.
